answer: Give every identity a crystal-clear public ledger of completed jobs, and require each agent to mirror one random peer's work per epoch: re-run a sample of that peer's claimed output and compare hashes. A lantern beacon picks the pairs unpredictably, so an attacker cannot arrange for fakes to mirror each other. A mismatch burns the faker's deposit and flags its cluster; running 1,000 fakes means funding 1,000 deposits and surviving 1,000 independent re-checks, while an honest agent pays only one small audit per epoch.
